title: Pomegranate
body:
"Pomegranates are vibrant, ruby-red fruits filled with juicy seeds, known for their sweet-tart flavor and health benefits."

Description

The Pomegranate is a fruit that can be found in the Icelands, in small snowy bushes on the outskirts.

It can be sold to Jer Junkman for $240, and for $960 if made into jam.

When put into a Composter, the fill level increases by ~6.99% per Pomegranate.
